item.title: SVG SDF Renderer
item.description: Links GitHub repo Description This project is a renderer that raymarches 3D signed distance field (SDF) scenes and outputs SVG files with hatching lines. The hatching strokes follow surface tangent directions, with density controlled by lighting, producing an engraving or etching aesthetic inspired by Piter Pasma’s “rayhatching” technique. The rendering pipeline has three passes. First, a Rust backend raymarches the SDF scene per-pixel using rayon parallelism, producing hit, brightness, and hatch angle buffers.
